Mainly used in peanut, potato and tomato fields to control a variety of fungal diseases, but also used in golf courses and lawns, but also can be added to paints, resins, emulsions and coatings as an anticorrosive additive to use. The prodrug contains traces of hexachlorobenzene and dioxins, which are persistent organic pollutants (POPs) banned under the Stockholm Convention. Mode of action: Multi-site touchdown activity (FRAC 2022). Affects bacterial glycolysis and energy metabolism.
